note: Clinton County MO publishes no queryable parcel service. The state county-resource layer lists its interactive mapper as clintoncountymo.giscloud.com (GIS Cloud, not an ArcGIS REST service) with no data download. The FetchGIS viewer (login-gated portal) and the assessor site (subscription) expose no public parcel endpoint. The statewide FMDC parcel service was not reachable (404 at gis.mo.gov/arcgis01 and ogi.oa.mo.gov) and its OA folder lists only state-owned parcels. Commercial vendors (Dynamo, Regrid, Rockford Map, Acres) are paid and not county-published.
